confirmed_helpers.name: PlayerGPower_IdentityIndex
confirmed_helpers.behavior: Validates owner_bank < 1, bakugan_id < 41, and attribute_id < 6, then returns the 41-by-6 table index.

confirmed_helpers.name: PlayerGPower_SetStored
confirmed_helpers.behavior: Converts G-Power to units of ten when the input is at least 10, then stores one byte at global_roster + index + 0x460.

confirmed_helpers.name: PlayerGPower_GetStored
confirmed_helpers.behavior: Loads one byte from global_roster + index + 0x460 and returns the value multiplied by 10.

confirmed_helpers.name: PlayerBakuganAux_GetRecord
confirmed_helpers.behavior: Returns global_roster + 0x88 + identity_index * 4; the two-halfword auxiliary record semantics remain unresolved.
